svg.title: Measured program cycles across RAM waits and cache configurations
svg.desc: Four workloads at RAM waits 1, 4 and 8. Lower cycles are better. All 48 plotted cases passed. Hit rates describe enabled caches; bypassed caches have no hit rate.
svg.text: Four cache configurations · fixed CPU and programs · lower is better
